parts.student_instructions: Read the bar graph. Answer 4 questions.
parts.visual_layout: Pre-built bar graph (4 categories). Below: 4 questions. The graph shows favourite sports.

image_placeholders.description: A pre-built bar graph for a Grade 2 worksheet, B&W line art. ~5in × 4in. Title 'Favourite Sport'. Y-axis labelled 'Number of children' (0-10). X-axis labelled with 4 sports: hockey (8), soccer (5), baseball (4), basketball (2). Bars drawn at correct heights. Below the graph, 4 questions.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P1_BAR at Part 1: instructions ask the child to read a bar graph. Keywords name the visual element and topic (sports).

parts.answer_key: Most popular = hockey (8). Least = basketball (2). Total surveyed = 19. Difference between hockey and soccer = 3.

parts.student_instructions: Use the tally to build a bar graph. Add title and labels.
parts.visual_layout: Tally chart (4 categories) + blank bar graph grid.

image_placeholders.description: Two parts for a Grade 2 worksheet. Top: tally chart with 4 rows: dogs ||||CROSS, cats ||||, fish ||, birds |||. Bottom: blank bar graph grid ~5in × 3in with empty axes for the child to label and draw bars.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P2_BUILD at Part 2: instructions ask the child to build a bar graph. Keywords name the source format and target format.

parts.answer_key: Bars: dogs=5, cats=4, fish=2, birds=3. Title (e.g., 'Favourite Pet'). X-axis labels: dogs/cats/fish/birds. Y-axis: 'Number of children'.

parts.student_instructions: Survey 5 classmates. Build a bar graph.
